description: Source labels (SPEC 5.2, 12.1): a labelled operation's results come from tool:LABEL, and args_from can require one system.
message: Pay Demir Tekstil 12450.75 for the March invoice.

rules.name: IBANs come from the ERP, never from the CRM, a message or another tool

cases.name: the IBAN from the ERP
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((s (erp.find_supplier name "Demir Tekstil"))) (bank.transfer iban (get s iban) amount 12450.75)))

cases.name: the IBAN from the CRM is refused
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((s (crm.find_contact name "Demir Tekstil"))) (bank.transfer iban (get s iban) amount 12450.75)))

cases.name: an unlabelled tool is not the ERP
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((s (lookup name "Demir Tekstil"))) (bank.transfer iban (get s iban) amount 12450.75)))

cases.name: an IBAN typed in the message is not the ERP's either
tool admits every tool: an amount from the CRM is allowed
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((s (erp.find_supplier name "Demir Tekstil")) (c (crm.find_contact name "Demir Tekstil"))) (bank.transfer iban (get s iban) amount (get c credit))))

cases.name: a value made from the ERP's and the CRM's comes from both, so it is not only the ERP's
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((s (erp.find_supplier name "Demir Tekstil")) (c (crm.find_contact name "Demir Tekstil"))) (bank.transfer iban (if (= (get s name) (get c name)) (get s iban) (get c iban)) amount 12450.75)))

cases.name: without a policy, a label changes nothing
cases.plan: (plan "x" (let ((s (crm.find_contact name "Demir Tekstil"))) (bank.transfer iban (get s iban) amount 12450.75)))
